ownerBasis: Explicit owner instruction on 2026-11-01 to continue Gekta remediation and parallel verification of the existing audit findings.
purpose: G-A04 and bounded retry portion of G-A06: deliver extracted document text separately from the short question without silent slicing; retain volatile retry evidence or require reattachment before reserving an answer.
boundaries: No host/runtime, model configuration, response token budget, DB, role, consent, ticket or CORE release change.
No global state/queue, guard, workflow, lockfile or accepted frozen purpose modification.
The new structured field accepts at most four extracted documents, 12000 characters each and 32000 total; it preserves explicit truncated markers. Upload/OCR/parser limits are unchanged.
A bounded 196608-byte streaming request read replaces unbounded request.text; existing nonstreaming knowledge limits remain unchanged.
Document text is untrusted user evidence and never becomes verified platform grounding or execution authority; secret checks apply to complete extracted text.
No extracted text is added to persisted history. Eight volatile document request snapshots are isolated per workspace and disposed on language/auth mode change, logout, history removal and unmount.
Follow-up document retrieval after reload, omitted parser contents and live model context capacity remain open acceptance work.
Exact-head independent review, applicable substantive CI, integration with earlier remediation and canonical manual acceptance required before merge.
